name: Yuedeng Huiye
source:
Lumina Fullmoon is an ancient Illuminator and one of the Sages who led the fledgling Illuminator civilization through crises.

[spoiler]In the War of Inlixa, she grew tired of conflicts and fled into the Land of Darkness with Inlixa's body.

She is the owner of the endless Dreamland Fancia and Alina fell into.[/spoiler]
